summary: Gamehaus Holdings Inc., a Shanghai-based foreign private issuer, furnished a Form -6-K containing a notice and proxy statement for an extraordinary general meeting on November 27, 2026, at 9:30 a.m. Eastern Time in Shanghai. The sole stated proposal is a ten-for-one share consolidation of Class A and Class B ordinary shares (par value raised to US$0.001), with authorized capital restated to 90,000,000 Class A and 10,000,000 Class B shares. No fractional shares will be issued; results are rounded up, and the board sets the Nasdaq post-consolidation trading date. No price, stake, premium, advisor, or deal terms are stated; this is a routine meeting notice, not a special situation.
